note: Development dialogue families with authored labels, for tuning and for testing the scoring harness. Not evaluation evidence. The held-out set uses the same format but is written by someone else and kept outside the repository (backend/conversation/guards.load_heldout).

labelFields.referent: Expected referent flight for an answer; null when the right response names no flight (clarify).
labelFields.mustCite: Fact IDs an answer must cite.
labelFields.explanationChanged: Expected value; omitted when not scored.
labelFields.unknowns: Properties that must be listed as unknown.
labelFields.observations: Expected visual observations for the referent: a value must be reported as that value; null means it must not be reported (not visible). Omitted kinds are not scored.
labelFields.textOnly: The same intent asked in words, with nothing selected (the text-only condition); its expect replaces the turn expect when given.
labelFields.lastSeen: Replay time when the board was last in view before this turn (tracking interruption).

families.tests: A correction to the next rotation moves the referent; only that rotation's facts are cited; a later revision is flagged.
